## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` and `mypy --strict src` pass.
- [ ] Tests cover the change. If it touches a rule in CONTRIBUTING.md, a test fails when the rule is broken.
- [ ] README, `docs/` and `.env.example` are updated if behaviour or settings changed.
- [ ] Nothing in the change or its tests needs a network call or a credential.
